requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep real private repository names and the real federation registry out of the public framework repository
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Private-by-default Gate forbids writing real private repository names into public framework repositories such as skillz.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require a sufficiently protected super-brain repository for the actual registry
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow defaults the real Super Brain to private and leaves federation pending if no sufficiently protected target exists.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: allow generic schemas examples and workflow rules to remain public
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly permits generic schemas, examples and workflow rules while keeping the real registry private.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: commit private repository names to a public framework registry
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: This is explicitly prohibited in the Private-by-default Gate.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy private child content into a less protected super brain
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow prohibits content movement to a less-protected federation layer.
